msg_summary: {parts} unique parts ({qty} total), {area} m2 of panel, about {sheets} sheet(s) at {sheet}
err_no_cabinets: spec must contain at least one cabinet
err_dim: cabinet {id}: {field} must be a positive number
err_thickness: panel thickness must be a positive number
err_sheet: sheet width/height must be positive numbers
err_material: materials.{role}: thickness must be a positive number
err_material_role: materials.{role} is not a valid role (side, bottom, top, shelf, divider, door, front, drawer)
err_groove_depth: cabinet {id}: groove_depth must be > 0 and < panel thickness
err_groove_fit: cabinet {id}: groove does not fit inside the panel depth
err_back_thickness: cabinet {id}: back thickness must be a positive number
err_shelves: cabinet {id}: shelves.count must be 0 or a positive integer
err_zones: cabinet {id}: zones must be a non-empty array
err_zone_type: cabinet {id}: zone {i} type must be 'open', 'door' or 'drawers'
err_zone_order: cabinet {id}: zone {i} 'from' must be a number less than 'to'
err_zone_overlap: cabinet {id}: zone {i} overlaps the previous zone
err_doors_count: cabinet {id}: zone {i} doors.count must be an integer 1..4
err_drawers_count: cabinet {id}: zone {i} drawers.count must be an integer 1..10
err_hinge_side: cabinet {id}: zone {i} hinge_side must be 'left' or 'right'
err_dividers: cabinet {id}: zone {i} dividers must be an array of positions
err_divider_pos: cabinet {id}: zone {i}: divider position must be a number inside the interior width
err_divider_gap: cabinet {id}: zone {i}: dividers overlap or are too close (need at least the divider thickness apart)
err_box_values: cabinet {id}: zone {i}: drawer box values must be positive and fit the cabinet
err_box_bottom: cabinet {id}: zone {i}: drawers.bottom must be 'lay-in' or 'grooved'
err_edge_role: edge_banding.{role} is not a valid part role
err_hw_name: hardware reference '{value}' not found in the library
viewer_drag: drag to rotate / scroll to zoom / click a part
viewer_tagline: Every shop has a carpenter. Now it has Najjar Pro.
chk_part_sheet: {id} ({w} x {h}) is bigger than the board ({sheet}) - it cannot be cut as one piece
chk_part_rotate: {id} fits the board ({sheet}) only rotated 90 degrees
chk_part_size: {id} has a zero or negative size
chk_door_narrow: cabinet {id} zone {i}: door is only {w} mm wide - consider fewer doors
chk_door_low: cabinet {id} zone {i}: door is only {h} mm high
chk_front_low: cabinet {id} zone {i}: drawer front is only {h} mm high
chk_box_tall: cabinet {id} zone {i}: drawer box ({box} mm) is taller than its front opening ({front} mm)
chk_box_narrow: cabinet {id} zone {i}: drawer box is only {w} mm wide
chk_hinges: cabinet {id} zone {i}: {n} hinges per door ({d} mm door)
chk_setback: cabinet {id} zone {i}: shelf setback is {s} mm - unusually deep
chk_groove_half: cabinet {id}: back groove ({g} of {t} mm) is more than half the panel - weak shoulders
